chapter: Opening, arrival in Los Angeles and the Quality Four
title: The Hazel Meyers tour that ended in Amarillo
summary: A tour with blues singer Hazel Meyers collapsed in Amarillo, Texas, when the money ran out and the rain came.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: And then it says here you went on tour with blues singer Hazel Meyers, but it ended in disaster in Amarillo, Texas a month or two later.
Well, we had to stop playing because they wouldn't --
They went broke, and the rain got us. It was raining, oh, boy.
So you had to disband everything?
Disband everything, come home. That was something, boy. I forget those things. Maybe Susie might remember them.
